title: Tier vector
description: A test vector of tiers (sections 12 and 25 of the format text): a skill graph and the tier of each of its skills. An implementation computes the tiers from the prerequisites and gets exactly these.

skill_graph.description: The skill graph, whose prerequisites among the module's skills run in no cycle.

skill_tiers.description: The tier of every skill of the graph, as the canonical view holds it.
